claims: Liverpool played PSG in the UEFA Champions League quarter-final second leg on April 14, 2026.
Liverpool started without Mohamed Salah, who was benched.
Liverpool opted for Alexander Isak and Hugo Ekitiké up front in a 4-2-3-1 formation.
PSG kept an unchanged 4-3-3 side from their first-leg 2-0 win.
PSG won the first leg 2-0.
The match ended 2-0 to PSG.
The aggregate score was 4-0 to PSG.
Liverpool's starting lineup was in a 4-2-3-1 formation.
Liverpool's starting goalkeeper was Giorgi Mamardashvili.
Liverpool's starting defenders were Jeremie Frimpong, Ibrahima Konaté, Virgil van Dijk (c), Milos Kerkez.
Liverpool's starting midfielders were Ryan Gravenberch, Alexis Mac Allister, Dominik Szoboszlai, Florian Wirtz.
Liverpool's starting forwards were Alexander Isak, Hugo Ekitiké.
Liverpool's substitutes were Woodman, Misciur, Gomez, Chiesa, Jones, Salah, Gakpo, Robertson, Nyoni, Nallo, Ngumoha.
PSG's starting lineup was in a 4-3-3 formation.
PSG's starting goalkeeper was Matvey Safonov.
PSG's starting defenders were Achraf Hakimi, Marquinhos (c), Willian Pacho, Nuno Mendes.
PSG's starting midfielders were Vitinha, João Neves, Warren Zaïre-Emery.
PSG's starting forwards were Ousmane Dembélé, Khvicha Kvaratskhelia, Désiré Doué.
PSG's substitutes were Chevalier, Marin, Lucas Beraldo, Zabarnyi, Goncalo Ramos, Kang-in Lee, Hernandez, Mayulu, Dro Fernandez, Barcola, Mbaye.
PSG's Marquinhos made a critical intervention to deny a goal early in the match.
PSG's Nuno Mendes was replaced by Lucas Hernandez due to injury.
Mohamed Salah was introduced as a substitute for Liverpool.
